annotation.summary: A man looks around and gestures in confusion when something expected is missing.

annotation.mechanism: The searching body language makes an absent instruction, missing feature, or unfamiliar setting visible.
scenarios: Look for the quick-start section in a confusing manual
Open a redesigned app and fail to find a familiar button
Arrive at a promised event and find nobody there
roles: Searching man: person unable to find what was expected

examples.why: The search is the reaction to a missing expected resource.

avoid: Avoid using the clip as generic anger; its main signal is puzzled searching.
